name: Autódromo José Carlos Pace
description: Interlagos in Sao Paulo, run anticlockwise. Downhill through the Senna S at the start, a long uphill run to the line, and rain that can arrive in minutes.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (1134 of 1724 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
